QuestInfo.name: Keeper of the Peace
QuestInfo.0: #P9120023# from Showa Town needs the help of a real hero.
QuestInfo.1:
You were tasked with defeating #o9400113# and #o9400019# troublemakers who have been disturbing the peace of Showa Town.

#t04000140#   #b#c04000140##k/5 
#t04000224#   #b#c04000224##k/5
QuestInfo.2: You taught a lesson to the #o9400113# and #o9400014# troublemakers. Hopefully that will make Showa Town a little safer.

0.0: You look tough! I have a request for you, if you're willing to listen.
0.1: #o9400113# and #o9400019# troublemakers have been running amok in Showa Town, damaging property and threatening the townspeople.
0.2: But the heroes we've enlisted to deal with them have proven to be no match. People have begun to lost hope.
0.3: But you... I think you're strong enough to beat them. Could you please lend us your aid?

yes.0: Oh, thank you. #o9400113#s can be found at \n#m801040100# and #o9400019#s can be found in the #m800000301#.
yes.1: It's dangerous but I know you you're up to the task. When you've finished teaching them a lesson, please bring me 5 #t04000140#s and #t04000224# as proof. I'll give you a special souvenir as thanks.

no.0: These are no easy foes. I'm not surprised you're having second thoughts. Let me know if you change your mind.

1.0: Hmm, with this there can be no doubt. Those menaces have finally been punished. Thank you.
1.1: I won't shed any tears for them. Anyways, please take this. Think of it as a little souvenir from Showa Town.

item.0: It's not that I don't believe you, but if you want your souvenir you'll have to bring me those  #t4000140# and #t4000224# I asked for. Sorry!
